title: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 Public reference cutout for Dwarka pilot
source_type: Digital Surface Model (DSM), includes buildings, infrastructure, and vegetation
extraction: Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF window read; clipped to the current schematic drainage-node extent plus 2 km buffer.
nominal_grid_spacing: 1 arc second (~31 m north-south; ~27 m east-west at this latitude)
global_accuracy_specification: <4 m absolute vertical accuracy at 90% linear error; product-level global statistic; local deviations can occur.
license: Free public GLO-30 access under Copernicus terms; include required source attribution when distributing.
required_attribution: Produced using Copernicus WorldDEM-30 © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved.
operational_use: REFERENCE ONLY. A 30 m DSM is not a street-scale bare-earth DTM; it is not hydrologically conditioned for this catchment and must not be used to claim street-depth accuracy.
validation_status: Not locally surveyed or validated against a control DEM.
